High pressure centred in the Atlantic covers the area.

##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##

North or Northwest 2 to 4, becoming Variable 3 or less tomorrow morning, settling Easterly 2 to 4 later.

Fair.

Good.
